# PT Misuba Guna Indonesia

> PT Misuba Guna Indonesia is a leading Indonesian industrial engineering supplier and plant maintenance contractor established in 2011. The company specializes in expansion joints, sealing systems, corrosion protection linings, industrial hoses, paper & pulp machinery, filtration systems, and full-scope on-site engineering field services.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity:** PT Misuba Guna Indonesia
- **Website:** https://misubaguna.com/
- **Main Sales Email:** sales@misubaguna.com / marketing@misubaguna.com
- **Phone:** +62 21 55660700
- **WhatsApp:** +62 811-8715-671
- **Operational & Warehouse:** Ruko Mutiara Karawaci Blok C29 & B36, Bencongan Indah, Kelapa Dua, Tangerang, Banten 15810, Indonesia
- **Billing Office:** Gedung STC Senayan Lantai 4 No 89, Jl. Asia Afrika, Gelora Senayan, Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia
- **Industries Served:** Power Generation, Petrochemical, Chemical Processing, Pulp & Paper, Palm Oil Milling, Mining, Water Treatment, Food & Beverage, Heavy Manufacturing.

## Industrial Engineering & Plant Maintenance Services

- [Cooling Tower Repair & Refurbishment](https://misubaguna.com/services/cooling-tower-repair/): Comprehensive repair, thermal overhaul, fill replacement, structural waterproofing, and fan drive maintenance for industrial cooling towers.
- [Heat Exchanger Service & Repair](https://misubaguna.com/services/heat-exchanger-repair/): On-site and workshop repair services for shell & tube and plate heat exchangers including retubing, hydrostatic testing, and re-gasket service.
- [Thermal Spray Coating](https://misubaguna.com/services/thermal-spray-coating/): High-performance thermal spray coating and metal spraying solutions to restore worn components and protect against extreme abrasion, heat, and corrosion.
- [Rubber Lining](https://misubaguna.com/services/rubber-lining/): Workshop and field application of rubber lining sheets for tanks, vessels, pipes, and agitators to resist chemical attack and heavy abrasion.
- [FRP Lining & Repair](https://misubaguna.com/services/frp-lining-repair/): Fiberglass Reinforced Plastic (FRP) lining and structural relining for chemical tanks, scrubber ducts, trenches, and containment bunds.
- [PTFE Lining & Bonding](https://misubaguna.com/services/ptfe-lining-bonding/): Expert bonding and sleeve fitting of PTFE and PFA liners for piping, columns, valves, and ultra-pure chemical process equipment.
- [Expansion Joint Installation & Replacement](https://misubaguna.com/services/expansion-joint-installation/): Field installation, splicing, alignment, and emergency replacement services for metal, fabric, rubber, and PTFE expansion joints.
- [Mechanical Maintenance & Repair](https://misubaguna.com/services/mechanical-maintenance/): Preventive and corrective mechanical maintenance services for pumps, valves, rotating shafts, couplings, and mechanical seals.
- [On-Site Inspection & Troubleshooting](https://misubaguna.com/services/onsite-inspection/): On-site technical evaluation, root cause failure analysis, NDT inspection, and shutdown consultation for critical plant equipment.
- [Valve Repair & Overhaul](https://misubaguna.com/services/valve-repair/): Complete workshop and on-site repair, seat lapping, seal replacement, and pressure testing for control valves, safety valves, gate/globe valves, and actuators.
- [Gearbox Repair & Rebuilding](https://misubaguna.com/services/gearbox-repair/): Comprehensive overhaul and rebuilding of helical, planetary, worm, and bevel industrial gearboxes, including gear re-machining, shaft alignment, and seal replacement.
- [Pump & Rotating Equipment Repair](https://misubaguna.com/services/pump-repair/): Field and workshop repair of centrifugal, slurry, positive displacement, and vacuum pumps including dynamic impeller balancing and mechanical seal retrofitting.

# Detailed Technical Catalog & Service Directory

## All Industrial Products

### Fabric Expansion Joint
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/fabric-expansion-joint/
- **Category:** Flexible Joint
- **Summary:** Custom non-metallic fabric expansion joints designed by PT Misuba Guna Indonesia for high-temperature ductwork, boiler exhaust lines, and severe vibration isolation.
- **Key Features:** Absorbs multi-directional thermal movement (axial, lateral, angular) without inducing spring rate stress on duct supports; Custom multi-layer composite belting tailored for continuous operating temperatures from 150°C to over 1000°C; Integrated ceramic fiber insulating belt protects gastight outer layers from direct thermal radiation; Easily field-welded or bolted to existing companion flanges with internal metal liner sleeves to prevent ash erosion; Zero maintenance fabric construction that eliminates fatigue cracking common in thin-gauge metal duct bellows
- **Materials:** Outer Cover: Silicone-coated glass cloth, Fluoroelastomer canvas, EPDM; Gas Barrier: Solid PTFE sheet foil, PTFE-impregnated fiberglass; Thermal Insulation: Needle-felted ceramic fiber blanket, high-silica glass mat; Reinforcement & Liner: SS304/SS316 wire mesh, internal SS304 flow sleeve, carbon steel backing bars
- **Applications:** Power plant boiler flue gas and turbine exhaust ducting (PLTU, PLTG, PLTU Biomass); Cement plant kiln preheaters, calciner ducts, and raw mill dust extraction lines; Steel mill sintering lines and blast furnace flue gas ductwork; Petrochemical incinerators and flare stack gas lines; Industrial boiler ID fan and FD fan inlet/outlet isolation joints

### Metal Expansion Joint
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/metal-expansion-joint/
- **Category:** Flexible Joint
- **Summary:** High-precision stainless steel and high-alloy bellows expansion joints engineered for thermal expansion compensation in high-pressure steam, oil, and gas piping.
- **Key Features:** Multi-ply bellows design provides high pressure capacity combined with low axial spring rate and maximum flex fatigue life; SS321 and SS316L standard bellows offer exceptional resistance to high-temperature scaling and stress corrosion cracking; Internal flow sleeves minimize pressure drop and prevent flow-induced vibration in high-velocity steam lines; External protective covers prevent external mechanical damage and debris accumulation in bellows convolutions; Available with fixed/floating flanges, butt-weld ends, or threaded pipe stubs matching international standards (DIN, ANSI, JIS)
- **Materials:** Bellows: SS304, SS316L, SS321, SS310S, Inconel 625, Hastelloy C-276; End Fittings: Carbon steel (A105, A234 WPB), SS304, SS316, or alloy steel; Internal Sleeve / External Shroud: SS304, SS316L, Heavy carbon steel
- **Applications:** High-pressure steam distribution headers and condensate return lines; Thermal oil heating systems in palm oil refineries (PKS) and oleochemical plants; Petrochemical refinery process piping and heat exchanger nozzle connections; District heating pipelines and power plant steam turbine cross-over piping; Marine engine exhaust manifolds and ballast water piping

### Rubber Expansion Joint
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/rubber-expansion-joint/
- **Category:** Flexible Joint
- **Summary:** Heavy-duty elastomeric rubber expansion joints designed to isolate pump vibration, absorb pipe movement, and compensate for misalignment in industrial water and fluid piping.
- **Key Features:** Outstanding vibration and sound attenuation for cooling water pumps, chillers, and compressors; High-tensile nylon cord and steel wire reinforcement prevents ballooning under surge pressure and vacuum conditions; Full-face rubber flange design creates a self-sealing joint, eliminating separate gasket requirements during installation; Elastomer tube options tailored for specific chemical resistance, oil compatibility, or potable water certification; Available with control rods (limit bolts) to prevent pipe over-extension and protect unanchored pump nozzles
- **Materials:** Inner Tube / Outer Cover: EPDM (water/steam), NBR (oil/fuel), Neoprene, Viton/FKM, Natural Rubber; Reinforcement: Nylon fabric cord, synthetic polyester yarn, spiral steel wire reinforcement rings; Retaining Flanges: Galvanized carbon steel, SS304, SS316
- **Applications:** Main cooling water pumps and condenser lines in power plants and manufacturing facilities; Water and wastewater treatment plant piping (WTP & WWTP); Palm oil mill effluent (POME) lines and raw water intake systems; Marine engine room sea chest cooling lines and bilge pumps; Industrial HVAC chilled water and condenser water circuits

### PTFE Expansion Joint
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/ptfe-expansion-joint/
- **Category:** Flexible Joint
- **Summary:** Molded virgin PTFE expansion joints engineered for ultra-pure liquids, highly aggressive acids, solvents, and reactive chemical piping lines.
- **Key Features:** 100% virgin PTFE construction provides total corrosion resistance against concentrated acids (HCl, H2SO4, HNO3), alkalis, and solvents; Non-contaminating, smooth non-stick inner surface prevents product build-up and complies with high-purity chemical standards; Low flexural modulus minimizes stress on delicate FRP, PVC, CPVC, and glass-lined vessel nozzles; Fitted with stainless steel tie-rods and limit washers to regulate axial compression, extension, and angular movement limits; Standard metallic root rings placed between convolutions prevent vacuum collapse and over-expansion under pressure
- **Materials:** Bellows Body: 100% Virgin PTFE (molded or machined convolutions), optional antistatic conductive PTFE; External Root Rings: SS304 or SS316 stainless steel wire rings; Backing Flanges: Ductile iron, Carbon steel with epoxy coating, SS304, or SS316; Tie-Rods: SS304/SS316 control tie-rods with rubber isolation bushings
- **Applications:** Chemical synthesis plants, acid pickling lines, and chlorine/caustic electrolysis facilities; Semiconductor and electronic chemical delivery systems; Fertilizer and phosphoric acid production lines; Pharmaceutical API manufacturing and ultra-pure water distribution; Pulp bleaching operations using chlorine dioxide

### PTFE Lined Expansion Joint (Rubber and Metal)
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/ptfe-lined-rubber-metal-expansion-joint/
- **Category:** Flexible Joint
- **Summary:** Hybrid expansion joints combining outer metal or rubber pressure strength with an internal continuous PTFE liner for severe chemical and high-pressure service.
- **Key Features:** Dual protection: Impermeable PTFE inner liner handles severe chemicals while outer elastomer/metal body bears high pressure and vibration; Seamless flare-over PTFE sealing faces fit directly against companion pipe flanges without needing separate gaskets; Eliminates chemical degradation of rubber compounds in hot hydrocarbon, solvent, or mixed acid applications; Absorbs high lateral displacement and vibration in dynamic chemical transfer lines; Vacuum-resistant liner configurations equipped with internal metallic or PTFE support rings
- **Materials:** Liner: Virgin PTFE sheet flare-formed into flange faces; Outer Body: EPDM / NBR rubber matrix with steel wire reinforcement, OR SS304/SS316 hydroformed bellows; Flanges: Carbon steel, Ductile Iron, SS304, or SS316
- **Applications:** Petrochemical refinery acid gas scrubber lines and hydro-cracking chemical feeds; Steel plant pickling bath recirculation pumps and waste acid lines; Mining slurry treatment facilities with high chemical and abrasive content; Chemical tanker ship unloading manifolds and offshore chemical dosing lines

### Rubber Hose
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/rubber-hose/
- **Category:** Flexible Joint
- **Summary:** Industrial-grade reinforced rubber hoses for safe, reliable transfer of water, oil, fuel, steam, food materials, and chemicals across manufacturing and mining sites.
- **Key Features:** Specialized tube compounds engineered for specific resistance to oils, petroleum fuels, hot water, steam, chemicals, or abrasive slurries; Heavy-duty outer cover resists weather, UV, ozone, abrasion, and dragging across rough industrial concrete floors; Steel wire helix reinforced options support full vacuum suction service without collapsing or kinking; Factory-crimped safety couplings ensure leak-free operation under high working pressures and pressure spikes; Wide range of flex tolerance for tight bend radius requirements in mobile equipment and factory drop lines
- **Materials:** Inner Tube: NBR (Oil/Fuel), EPDM (Steam/Hot Water), SBR (Abrasives/Water), White FDA EPDM (Food), Hypalon; Reinforcement: High-tensile synthetic cord, steel wire helix; Cover: Weather & abrasion resistant EPDM, NBR/PVC blend, Neoprene; Fittings: Stainless steel SS316, SS304, Aluminum, Brass, Carbon Steel
- **Applications:** Plant air lines, water washdown, and pneumatic tool supply; Diesel fuel, lubricant, and hydraulic oil transfer in palm oil mills and mining fleets; Cement powder, dry fly ash, and sand suction/discharge lines; Food & beverage liquid transfer (milk, palm olein, syrup, potable water); Chemical transfer hoses for chemical dosing stations and tank truck unloading

### Flexible Metal Hose
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/flexible-metal-hose/
- **Category:** Flexible Joint
- **Summary:** Precision corrugated stainless steel flexible hose assemblies designed for severe thermal cycles, extreme high pressures, cryogenic media, and gas-tight fluid transfer.
- **Key Features:** 100% gas-tight annular corrugated stainless steel tube eliminates permeation of hazardous gases and liquids; High-density SS wire braiding absorbs internal hoop stress, allowing working pressures up to 300+ bar; Unmatched temperature resilience from cryogenic liquid nitrogen (-200°C) to high-temperature engine exhaust (+600°C); Fire-safe construction prevents sudden rupture during plant emergency fire conditions; Custom welded end fittings (ANSI/JIS flanges, unions, thread nipples, quick couplers) tested per ISO 10380 standards
- **Materials:** Corrugated Hose Tube: SS304, SS316L, SS321; Braid Mesh: SS304 or SS316 stainless steel wire braid (Single or Double layer); End Fittings: Carbon Steel, SS304, SS316L (Flanged, Union, BSP/NPT Threaded, Weld Ends, Camlock)
- **Applications:** Steam header connections to moving press platens in plywood and palm oil plants; Gas turbine fuel supply lines, burner hoses, and generator vibration isolation; Chemical reactor feed lines, acid loading arms, and LPG/LNG transfer hoses; High-pressure hydraulic and compressor discharge lines; Thermal expansion loops for solar thermal and power plant piping

### PTFE Lining
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/ptfe-lining/
- **Category:** Corrosion Protection
- **Summary:** Advanced fluoropolymer PTFE lining solutions applied to pipes, fittings, vessels, and chemical columns to provide an impermeable, non-stick chemical barrier against aggressive acids and high temperatures.
- **Key Features:** Complete chemical inertness against concentrated nitric, sulfuric, hydrochloric, and hydrofluoric acids up to 260°C; Thick-wall paste extruded PTFE liner prevents permeation and thermal vacuum collapse in continuous vacuum lines; Seamless flared-over sealing faces eliminate separate gaskets at pipe spool and vessel flange connections; Ultra-smooth non-stick surface coefficient prevents scaling, chemical fouling, and pressure drop in transfer lines; 100% Non-destructive electro-spark tested (20kV+ DC) to guarantee zero pinholes or micro-cracks before dispatch
- **Materials:** Liner Material: 100% Virgin PTFE, Conductive PTFE (Antistatic), PFA, FEP; Substrate Steel: Carbon Steel (A106 Gr B, A53), SS304, SS316L, ASTM A395 Ductile Iron fittings; Flange Standards: ANSI B16.5 Class 150/300, DIN EN 1092-1, JIS B2220
- **Applications:** Petrochemical acid wash columns, chlorine headers, and pickling acid recirculation loops; Agrochemical and fertilizer manufacturing acid feed lines; Pharmaceutical API synthesis reactors and high-purity solvent transfer lines; Power plant FGD (Flue Gas Desulfurization) chemical dosing and neutralization tanks; Palm oil oleochemical fatty acid distillation columns and chlor-alkali plants

### Rubber Lining
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/rubber-lining/
- **Category:** Corrosion Protection
- **Summary:** Heavy-duty elastomeric rubber lining applications applied to tanks, pipes, slurry pumps, and process vessels for severe acid corrosion protection and coarse particle abrasion resistance.
- **Key Features:** Dual protection: Exceptional impact and slurry abrasion resistance combined with complete acid and alkali barrier protection; Available in soft rubber (40-60 Shore A) for high-velocity particle impact and hard ebonite (75-80 Shore D) for chemical immersion; Superior elastomeric flexibility dampens structural vibration and accommodates thermal contraction without cracking; High-bond strength adhesive system (>10 N/mm peel strength) prevents liner disbondment under vacuum or pressure swings; Cold-bonding site repair systems available for quick field maintenance of tank linings without autoclave requirement
- **Materials:** Rubber Compounds: Natural Rubber (Soft & Ebonite Hard), Chlorobutyl, Bromobutyl, EPDM, Neoprene, Synthetic NBR; Bonding System: Multi-layer chemlok/isocyanic adhesive primer systems; Lining Thickness: Standard 3mm, 4mm, 6mm, up to 25mm multi-ply build-up
- **Applications:** Mining ore slurry pipelines, hydrocyclones, flotation cells, and ball mill shells; Power plant FGD scrubber towers, slurry recirculation pumps, and gypsum slurry tanks; Phosphoric acid storage tanks, water treatment demineralizer vessels, and cation/anion beds; Chemical processing transport tankers, acid pickling vats, and waste neutralization pits; Palm oil mill effluent (POME) treatment tanks and coastal seawater intake pipes

### Ceramic Lining
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/ceramic-lining/
- **Category:** Corrosion Protection
- **Summary:** High-density 92% and 95% Alumina ceramic tile lining systems for extreme abrasive wear, sliding friction, and erosion in mining, cement, coal, and bulk material handling.
- **Key Features:** Diamond-hard 92%/95% Alumina ceramic tiles provide unmatched resistance to sliding abrasion and fine particle erosion; Rubber-cushioned ceramic composite panels absorb severe rock impact while eliminating ceramic tile fracture; Weld-through ceramic tiles with tapered steel lock cups ensure secure mechanical attachment under high thermal stress; Extends component service life up to 10x longer than hardfaced overlay plates, reducing unplanned plant shutdown; Custom engineered interlocking sleeve segments for pipe elbows and cyclones eliminate exposed adhesive seams
- **Materials:** Ceramic Media: 92% Alumina (Al2O3), 95% Alumina, Zirconia-Toughened Alumina (ZTA), Silicon Carbide (SiC); Backing & Bonding: High-impact natural rubber matrix, Two-part high-temperature epoxy resin adhesive; Fixation Hardware: Weldable steel caps, Countersunk SS304 studs, Interlocking tongue-and-groove joints
- **Applications:** Cement plant raw meal chutes, clinker transfer hoppers, cyclone dipleg pipes, and separator cones; Power plant pulverized coal burner lines, bottom ash sluice pipes, and coal bunker chutes; Mining mineral processing plant chutes, slurry launders, vibrating screen hoppers, and hydrocyclones; Steel mill iron ore sinter transfer points and coke handling chutes; Glass manufacturing silica sand pneumatic convey lines

### FRP Lining
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/frp-lining/
- **Category:** Corrosion Protection
- **Summary:** Seamless glass-fiber reinforced plastic (FRP / GRP) composite lining systems applied on steel, concrete, and brick structures for heavy chemical, acid, and wastewater corrosion protection.
- **Key Features:** Custom resin selection (Vinyl Ester, Novolac, Isophthalic) matched to specific acid, solvent, or alkali exposure; Monolithic, jointless composite lining seals concrete cracks and prevents chemical seepage into surrounding groundwater; High mechanical strength-to-weight ratio allows structural rehabilitation of thin-wall corroded steel tanks; Integral C-glass synthetic surface veil provides a resin-rich (>80%) chemical barrier preventing fiber prominence; Excellent thermal expansion match with concrete and steel, preventing delamination during seasonal temperature cycles
- **Materials:** Resin Matrix: Novolac Vinyl Ester (Derakane 470/411), Bisphenol A, Premium Isophthalic Polyester; Reinforcement: E-glass Chopped Strand Mat (CSM 300/450/600 g/m²), Woven Roving (WR 600), C-glass surface veil; Primers: Moisture-tolerant epoxy primer for concrete, Silane-treated steel primer
- **Applications:** Chemical plant primary and secondary containment dikes, bund walls, and floor trenches; Wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) equalization tanks, clarifiers, and acid neutralization pits; Power plant demisalization water storage tanks and chemical dosing sumps; Pulp and paper chemical storage vessels and bleach plant effluent gutters; Electroplating acid rinse tanks and battery room floor protection

### Ceramic Coating
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/ceramic-coating/
- **Category:** Corrosion Protection
- **Summary:** Advanced liquid ceramic polymer coatings and thermal spray ceramic barriers applied to metal components to prevent high-temperature oxidation, cavitation, erosion, and chemical corrosion.
- **Key Features:** Restores cavitated pump impellers and volutes to original hydraulic efficiency, reducing power consumption; Ultra-smooth ceramic finish improves fluid hydrodynamic flow efficiency by up to 3-5% while preventing erosion; High micro-hardness ceramic particles protect pump casings and valve seats against severe particle impact and cavitation; Exhibits superior dielectric strength, eliminating galvanic corrosion between dissimilar metal assemblies; High thermal barrier properties protect boiler tubes and engine manifolds from high-temperature gas scaling
- **Materials:** Polymer Base: Ceramic-reinforced 100% solids epoxy matrix (solvent-free), Novolac epoxy ceramic; Ceramic Fillers: Micro-spherical Alumina (Al2O3), Silicon Carbide (SiC), Quartz flour; Thermal Spray Ceramics: Chromium Oxide (Cr2O3), Alumina-Titania (Al2O3-TiO2 87/13)
- **Applications:** Cooling water pump casings, impellers, suction bells, and cutlass bearing journals; Plate heat exchanger end plates, tube sheets, and water box covers; Slurry pump volutes, dredging pump components, and hydrocyclone bodies; Industrial control valves, butterfly valve discs, and sea chest strainers; Boiler economizer tubes, exhaust fan blades, and duct expansion sleeves

### PTFE Coating
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/ptfe-coating/
- **Category:** Corrosion Protection
- **Summary:** Precision industrial PTFE / Xylan fluoropolymer coating service applied to fasteners, valves, molds, and process components for non-stick release, low friction, and salt-spray corrosion protection.
- **Key Features:** Ultra-low coefficient of friction (0.05 to 0.10) prevents thread galling and breakout torque spikes on industrial stud bolts; Exceptional salt-spray corrosion resistance (>1500 to 3000+ hours ASTM B117 salt spray test) for offshore marine fasteners; Superior non-stick release properties prevent sticky polymer, rubber, food, or chemical residue adhesion on mold tooling; Chemically resistant to solvents, fuel, hydraulic fluids, and weathering without degrading or flaking; Food-contact compliant (FDA 21 CFR) formulations available for food processing and packaging machinery
- **Materials:** Coating Systems: PTFE (Polytetrafluoroethylene), PFA, FEP, Xylan® 1014 / 1424 fluoropolymer resin matrices; Primer Layer: Zinc phosphate, Epoxy-polyamide primer, Chromate-free corrosion inhibitor primer; Substrate Compatibility: Carbon Steel, Alloy Steel (B7/B16), SS304/SS316, Inconel, Aluminum, Brass
- **Applications:** Offshore oil & gas subsea stud bolts, nuts, and flange fastener assemblies (Xylan coated ASTM A193 B7/B16); Chemical control valve plugs, ball valve spheres, and actuator internal components; Rubber and plastic molding dies, tire molds, and thermoforming tooling; Food & bakery dough hoppers, heat sealing jaws, and conveyor guide rails; Automotive fuel rail components, throttle shafts, and lock mechanisms
